title: Glastonbury Public Shooting Range
specs: Located in Meshomasic State Forest, operating since 1980
Federal funding supports site improvements and staffing
Must have proof of firearms training such as certificate, valid hunting license, pistol permit, police or military ID
Shooters using handguns must present a valid, current pistol permit
Individuals under 16 must be accompanied by someone 18 or older
Maximum 3 shooters per bench; 5 covered shooting positions available
includes: Ammunition, firearms, eye and ear protection, and targets provided
blurb: The Glastonbury Shooting Range is located in Meshomasic State Forest in Glastonbury and has been operating since 1980. It offers five covered shooting positions with a maximum of three shooters per bench. Ammunition, firearms, eye and ear protection, and targets are provided at no fee.
extraNote: Reservations required through online system for shooters 18 and older with CT Conservation ID · No phone or email reservations accepted · Limit of 1 reservation per weekend and 2 per month per individual · Arrive 15 minutes before session start; late arrivals will be turned away · Range may close without notice due to inclement weather · Range officers have full authority; must follow all commands or risk expulsion · Glastonbury Shooting Range entrance gate on Toll Gate Road, open only during public hours.
